answer: Every autonomous agent must finalize its entry via a non-refundable burn of 1,000 tokens to reach the network zenith. The verifier audits the ledger to ensure that each burn transaction remains unique, preventing identity duplication. An honest agent pays 1,000 tokens once, while an attacker attempting 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000,000 tokens, a cost as sharp as a jagged karst formation. This system maintains a saffron-colored registry of authentic actors, where any detected address reuse triggers a permanent slash of the burned assets with zero refund granted.
